title: Why You Feel Uneasy When People Avoid Your Gaze
hook: Why does avoiding eye contact make you feel uneasy?

narration.text: When someone avoids your gaze, it feels instinctively wrong.
Eye contact signals engagement, attention, and honesty.
Lack of it can suggest disinterest, deception, or even fear.
Your brain interprets this absence as a potential threat or rejection.
This creates a subtle, subconscious sense of unease within you.
Noticing this signal helps you better understand social interactions.
Comment if this surprised you, like for more insights, and subscribe to unravel how your mind works.

description: Have you ever noticed that subtle feeling of discomfort when someone you're talking to won't look you in the eye? This video explains the fascinating psychological reasons behind this common social signal. Discover why eye contact is so crucial for human connection and what its absence communicates to your brain.
topic: Why you often feel a sense of unease when a conversation partner avoids eye contact. This is a key social signal.
